answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fake-identity behaviour: one identity, one bond, locked in a dune of pooled collateral that no single operator can cheaply refill. Each action carries a signed thread linking it to that bond, so sockpuppets share one fate instead of many free lives. Reputation then grows only along a slow spiral — small verified jobs first, larger trust later — so an attacker must pay real time and capital per identity, and a Sybil farm collapses under its own cost.
